pre_edit_verification.description: Verified actual and gzip-decoded admitted originals before edits, protected pins and accepted-unowned files/reviews. Root prospectively qualified current-owned overlapping pins; no demand that changed outputs retain old hashes. Reused root entry board VALID1839 and scoped 0-error/125-warning baseline (2ade5a to 98f712). Root admission board VALID1857 (79b6f6 to 1d2539) reported current. No worker board or baseline suite.

baseline_case: Source-confirmed absence of a safe caller-buffered HTTP branch: original timestamps can become live activity/retention or lose intended current-interest purpose. User approved original-time decayed interest plus eligible measurement, without receipt-time visits, ODP activity, regional geolocation counts, demo capture or retention refresh. No failed runtime baseline claimed.
implementation: Flat explicit HTTP processing:'buffered' requires existing strict nonce/time representation, nonfuture original timestamp (zero valid, no maximum age) and original browsingSessionId string or explicit null. Direct object rejects nested event wrappers; marked WebSocket frames reject before state work. Unsigned session-engine buffered input cannot enter legacy get-or-create.

Shared narrow helper observes the current erasure barrier, uses existing canonical top-level product/event or content touches and applyHistorical plus tick at server evaluation time, under current tenant config. Local qualification receives unchanged behavioral attributes, new reflex inputs and empty previous-derived segments; independently unions profile enrichment and legacy-authorized ODP membership. Failed qualification does not claim refreshed membership.

Session host reads only an existing exact owned nonforwarded validated record. Narrow refusal/interest writes preserve unrelated original fields, exact scoped list-key absolute expiry and metadata (including nonexpiring records), do not write user pointers, and refuse unverifiable expiry/state or expiry below platform minimum60s.

Object branch remains inside existing serialize and rate admission, captures evaluation time when dequeued, rechecks capability before reads/after stored validation/after awaited qualification, validates prior audience ownership without blessing absent/null, and commits candidate affinity/pipeline before publishing mirrors. Keeps lastSeen and retention deadline, advancing only an earlier computed audience/retention alarm.

Both hosts bypass live counters, metadata/journey/visit updates, profile cookies, ODP refresh/forwarding, region fan-in and demo capture. Tracking refusal blocks measurement, personalization refusal permits eligible measurement only. Outcome submission retains original event/time/browsing session including null/decision reference through existing ledger and online path.

Exactly four grouped cases added to the existing SDK-contract fixture, plus a local fixture helper/import. Two selected W09.05/W26.02 controls and all unselected existing cases remain unchanged. API documents explicit protocol, top-level touch limitation and non-durable/non-idempotent/current-policy limits.
